project.title: Native durable keyed mutation receipts
project.goal: Atomic caller-owned domain effects and stable durable receipt replay with immutable tombstones
project.scope: Storage primitive and current human fence composition, not full native post/reverse or deployment

boundary.responsibility: Validated stable receipt scope, canonical payload, source-compatible outcome/audit and retention inside admitted caller write transaction
boundary.rationale: Cross-interface retries and key rotation must never duplicate company effects or release revoked outcomes
excludes: Complete posting/reversal/domain gates, actual service company admission and physical/deployed runtime qualification

scenario.then: Fresh source-compatible receipt and same-payload replay execute domain effects once

action.idempotency.description: Execute or replay one keyed mutation in caller transaction

trusted_authorized_transaction.description: Current authenticated stable principal, explicit actor, trusted clock and admitted main writer

output.description: Uncommitted outcome and receipt; application releases only after known commit

errors.refused: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / IDEMPOTENCY_OUTCOME_EXPIRED with optional diagnostic audit; storage/domain rejection requires rollback

preconditions: Current operation authorization before receipt lookup/replay
Admitted canonical physical company and main write transaction; synchronous trusted callback
postconditions: Successful business effects, tombstone, outcome and audit share caller commit
Replay invokes no domain callback; stable subject survives credential/actor/path change
All errors require caller rollback; pruned keys remain permanently reserved
external_effects: Business callback, append-only tombstone/outcome and idempotency audit inside one SQLite transaction
Retention deletes only expired outcomes; no network/mail/production effects

authorization.rationale: Replay disclosure and duplicate effects require current authorization, stable scope, atomic domain/receipt/audit, bounded canonical bytes, retained tombstones and actual writer/crash checks

action.idempotency.behavior: Authorize before invocation; canonical stable scope; domain+receipt+audit atomic caller commit; every error aborts caller; preserve permanent tombstone
